summary:
Decision announced by Camila Reyes: November 2nd. 1 open question, 3 open blockers, 1 person took an explicit position on an option.

Camila Reyes announced the go-live date for the claims dashboard as November 2nd with the manual refresh. Mei Tran had supported November 2nd before the announcement, citing regional leads asking since September. No reply was recorded after the announcement from Erik Lindqvist, Mei Tran, or Nneka Abara.

## Open questions

- Whether the duplicate-claims bug fix will be merged and tested before November 2nd — the condition Nneka Abara attached to her acceptance (raised by Nneka Abara).

## Where people stand

- Mei Tran: "From the business side, November 2nd" — regional leads have been asking since September; offered her team to run the manual refresh for the first month.
- Erik Lindqvist first said he had no one to run the Monday manual refresh; then said "that changes my view — I'm fine with the second then" once Mei Tran's team offered to cover. Said the duplicate-claims bug "is fixed in the branch."
- Nneka Abara: "I'd still rather wait for the 16th — the manual refresh has a known bug with duplicate claims — I don't want the regional leads to see bad numbers." Said "if it's merged and tested, I'm okay with the second."
- Jonas Voss: "I won't sign off without it" — compliance review of the access list must happen first and takes five business days once he receives it.

## What is blocking progress

- The duplicate-claims bug fix must be merged and tested before go-live on November 2nd (raised by Nneka Abara).
- No one is assigned to cover the Monday manual refresh for the week of the 9th; Mei Tran said she will be out that week (raised by Camila Reyes). Deferred to follow-up.
- Jonas Voss requires the access list to begin his five-day compliance review and will not sign off without it (raised by Jonas Voss).

## Next steps

- Nneka Abara will get Jonas Voss the access list by Friday the 23rd (Camila Reyes asked; Nneka Abara committed).
- Mei Tran's team will run the Monday manual refresh for the first month (Mei Tran committed).
- Erik Lindqvist will confirm the bug fix is merged by Wednesday (Erik Lindqvist committed).
- Camila Reyes asked that someone else cover the week-of-the-9th Monday refresh; no owner assigned.

## Awaiting a reply

- Camila Reyes called for someone to cover the Monday refresh the week of the 9th; no volunteer replied. Camila Reyes said "we'll figure out that week" with no resolution recorded.

## Things people asserted that others may want to check

- Erik Lindqvist said the duplicate-claims bug "is fixed in the branch" and will confirm it is merged by Wednesday.
- Mei Tran said regional leads have been asking for the dashboard since September.
